text: ずっと　わたしの　こと　みてるでしょ

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on; てる is the short spoken form. ずっと みてる = 'you've been looking the whole time'.

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a person means 'things about' that person and is often just a softer way to say the person. わたしの こと = 'me'.

patterns.name: 〜でしょう
patterns.explanation: でしょう at the end pushes the listener to agree, like 'aren't you?'; でしょ is the short spoken form. みてるでしょ = 'you're looking, aren't you?'
